extraction.summary_en: Minutes of the sole shareholder (HADEAN) of ARCHEAN Technologies dated 27 June 2008, followed by the updated statutes. The filing (i) splits the nominal value of shares by 100 (capital unchanged at €200,000), (ii) creates two new preference share classes (A, and B/B'), (iii) resolves two capital increases in cash (€17,241 issuing 17,241 Actions A, and €150,861 issuing 150,861 Actions B with attached BSOC), bringing capital to €368,102, and (iv) transfers the registered office. The attached updated statutes already show the capital at €368,102 divided into 217,241 A shares and 150,861 B shares, so both increases are treated as realised by this filing.

evidence.quote_fr: ARTICLE 7 - CAPITAL SOCIAL Le capital social est fixé à la somme de 368.102 euros. Il est divisé en 368.102 actions de 1 euro chacune entièrement libérées. ... 217.241 actions de préférence de catégorie A, 150.861 actions de préférence de catégorie B.

issues: Resolution 1 divides the nominal value of shares by 100 (200,000 shares of €1 replacing 2,000 of €100); capital unchanged at €200,000, so no CAPITAL_INCREASE/DECREASE event was recorded, only a snapshot note.

The two capital increases (Augmentation de Capital I and II) were decided subject to a subscription period running until 18 July 2008 (after this filing's deposit date of 15 July 2008) and to suspensive conditions (adoption of other resolutions), yet the statutes attached to and dated the same day as this act already show the final capital of €368,102 fully realised; this is treated per instructions as completed_here but the timing is internally inconsistent and could not be fully resolved from this document.

Named subscribers to Augmentation de Capital I and II ('personnes dénommées') are referenced (resolutions 10 and 12-15) but not included in the OCR provided, so SHAREHOLDER_ENTRY/subscribers could not be determined.
Resolution 7 (referenced by numbering gap between 6th and 8th resolutions) is missing from the OCR.
